q.preorder: Which ordering system lets my customers order ahead and pick a collection time?
q.capacity: My truck gets swamped at peak times — which system limits the orders for each time slot?
q.whatsapp: Customers keep asking where I am — which system answers them on WhatsApp?
q.social: Which system makes the posts for my weekly locations, so I don’t have to design graphics?
q.schedule: I trade somewhere different most days — which system shows customers where I am and takes orders for that stop?
q.priceLow: I only trade a few days a month — which system costs the least?
q.priceHigh: I do festivals and busy events — which system costs the least?
q.commission: I don’t want to pay commission on every order — what does each product charge?
q.offline: What happens to online orders if my signal drops?
